name: issues_close
description: Close one issue on Ledgerline's tracker, with the reason stated for the people who read it. The result is JSON {issue, closed, reason}; it is never empty when the issue was closed. Safe to retry: the harness keys every write, so a repeat returns the close already made. The reason is at most 300 characters.

issue.description: The issue to close, such as issue-4192.

reason.description: Why it is closed, in one sentence, such as: Duplicate of issue-4188, which tracks the same failure. At most 300 characters.

input.reason: Duplicate of issue-4188, which tracks the same failure.
Fixed in the README on develop; the setup steps now name npm run dev.

examples.note: a hard case: say where the fix is, so a reader can check it
